More Than a Safari Booking

Blossoms Adventures helps travellers discover Kenya while giving hotels and lodges a simple channel for partnership and guest referrals.

  • Safari and tour planning
  • Accommodation coordination
  • Camping and outdoor experiences
  • Private and group travel requests
  • Hotel and lodge partnership enquiries

Hotels & Lodges: Partner With Us

Hotels, camps and lodges can use this page to introduce their property, discuss rates, receive guest referrals and explore collaboration with Blossoms Adventures.

What We Can Discuss

  • Preferred partner or agent rates
  • Guest accommodation referrals
  • Safari + accommodation packages
  • Group and corporate stays
  • Camping and activity coordination

How It Works

1. Send your property details.

2. We discuss rates, availability and partnership terms.

3. Your property can be considered for suitable client itineraries.

4. Guest booking and payment arrangements are agreed directly with the property or through an agreed process.
